responsibility: This file implements C expression construction and semantic type checking. It builds typed trees for operators, calls, casts, initializers, returns, va_arg, and other expressions; enforces C compatibility, qualifier, composite-type, pointer, array-to-pointer, and lvalue rules; performs assignment and argument conversions with diagnostics; tracks contexts such as sizeof/typeof/alignof and OpenMP loops; and provides core comparison helpers such as comptypes, null-pointer-constant detection, tree equality, and implicit-function-declaration status. It is most relevant when C parsing has succeeded but expression typing, initializer nesting, conditional/binary operator semantics, argument conversion, or type compatibility decisions are wrong.
